title: Bison reports its conflicts
description: The tutorial's sr.y, rr.y and de.y run through bison -v so it reports each conflict, then tiny.y built and run on the tutorial's two inputs. It runs in gcc:14 with bison installed in setup.

files.sr.y:
%token ID
%%
e: e '+' e | e '*' e | ID ;
%%
files.de.y:
%token IF THEN ELSE COND OTHER
%%
s: IF COND THEN s
 | IF COND THEN s ELSE s
 | OTHER
 ;
%%
